items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Well, he joined, just after I left Barnet, we heard him from Boston.

ctx.x: Well, tell us about that because Ralph Burns is probably one of the most formidable arrangers in the world.

Well, he joined, just after I left Barnet, we heard him from Boston. You see, with Barnet's band -- which I hadn't touched on before because we skipped over so many things -- we played the Apollo Theatre 21 times. We were the first white band to play the Apollo Theatre, and of course, we always had a black and white band. Now after Benny Goodman ...
